description: Land %VText/VLines/VFlow/VRow/VBox/VZone/VMemo/VHole/VCursor structs and the single-pass painter (LineBuf as {iolist_rev, line_iolist_rev, visible_width, line_count}). Memo-cell shape is {iodata, visible_width, cursor_offset_or_nil} so cursor coords survive cache hits. Compat adapter wraps existing Component.render/2 outputs as VLines so nothing changes visually. Telemetry: [:octo_pi_tui, :vdom, :paint] reports nodes_visited / memo_hits / memo_misses / line_count / byte_count / duration. Hard rules: no ++, no flat_map, no List.flatten in the hot path. Tests: unit fixtures for border math, zone welding, padding, memo hit/miss, cursor stamping through nested boxes.
title: VDom core: VNode types, LineBuf, paint phase, Compat adapter behind feature flag
